imperium.building.armory.desc: Allows recruiting knights. New recruits get better equipment.
imperium.building.bank.desc: +15% gold income and +1000 storage for all resources.
imperium.building.barracks.desc: Allows recruiting militia and swordsmen. Soldiers are trained here.
imperium.building.farm.desc: +8 food per cycle (+3 with Agriculture). Crops in your territory grow faster.
imperium.building.fortress.desc: Province cores of your nation have double HP. Resistance for your people at war, soldiers take less damage at home.
imperium.building.granary.desc: +600 food storage, people eat 10% less. Protects against famine.
imperium.building.hospital.desc: Regeneration in your territory, soldiers heal 3x faster, faster population growth.
imperium.building.house.desc: Build any house you like: walls, a door and beds. Every bed houses 2 people (max 10).
imperium.building.hut.desc: A cosy wooden hut. Houses 4 people.
imperium.building.manor.desc: A brick manor for the well-off. Houses 10 people.
imperium.building.market.desc: +6 gold per cycle, +4 happiness, trade agreements bring much more gold.
imperium.building.mine.desc: +8 stone and +2.5 iron per cycle. Your people get Haste in your territory.
imperium.building.siege_workshop.desc: Allows recruiting sappers who deal 6x damage to province cores.
imperium.building.smeltery.desc: Furnaces in and around it smelt 3x faster. Steel Furnaces work only here. Turns 2 iron into 1 steel every cycle. Pollution: -4 happiness.
imperium.building.stone_house.desc: A solid stone house. Houses 6 people.
imperium.building.tavern.desc: +6 happiness, -2 food. Where rumours (and volunteers) are born.
imperium.building.temple.desc: +10 happiness. Luck for your people in your territory.
imperium.building.watchtower.desc: Reveals enemy units within 96 blocks on the strategic map. +2 happiness (people feel safe).
imperium.dlg.bye.1: Mind the mud on your way out.
imperium.dlg.bye.2: Come back when you have bread.
imperium.dlg.gift.abundant.0: Thanks, but I've eaten seven times today. I'll give it to the pig.
imperium.dlg.gift.abundant.1: More food? I'll need a bigger belt.
imperium.dlg.gift.famine.0: Food! Real food! Bless you, %1$s, bless your children and their goats!
imperium.dlg.gift.famine.1: I'll share it with my little ones. They haven't eaten in three days.
imperium.dlg.gift.famine.2: *sobs* I had forgotten what this tastes like.
imperium.dlg.gift.foreign.0: A gift from a foreigner? Maybe your people aren't so bad after all.
imperium.dlg.gift.foreign.1: Thank you, stranger. I'll tell everyone in %2$s about your kindness.
imperium.dlg.gift.normal.0: Oh, thank you! I'll save it for supper.
imperium.dlg.gift.normal.1: How kind! You're nothing like the tax collectors.
imperium.dlg.greet.abundant.0: Ah, %1$s! Have a sausage. Have two! The cellars of %2$s are bursting!
imperium.dlg.greet.abundant.1: Three dinners a day and a nap in between. Life in %2$s is good!
imperium.dlg.greet.abundant.2: I've put on so much weight my horse filed for retirement.
imperium.dlg.greet.enemy.0: Don't hurt me! I'm just a simple peasant!
imperium.dlg.greet.enemy.2: You won't break the spirit of %2$s! ...Please don't break anything else either.
imperium.dlg.greet.famine.0: Please... a crust of bread, %1$s. Anything.
imperium.dlg.greet.famine.1: I boiled my boots yesterday. Today I'm eyeing the laces.
imperium.dlg.greet.famine.2: Forgive me if I faint mid-sentence. The granaries of %2$s are empty.
imperium.dlg.greet.famine.3: We buried three neighbours this week. Hunger doesn't knock before it enters.
imperium.dlg.greet.foreign.0: A traveller from afar! What brings you to %2$s?
imperium.dlg.greet.foreign.1: You talk funny. Not from around here, are you?
imperium.dlg.greet.foreign.2: Welcome to %2$s, stranger. Wipe your boots.
imperium.dlg.greet.happy.0: What a lovely day in %5$s! Even the cows are smiling.
imperium.dlg.greet.happy.2: I'd sing, but my neighbours have suffered enough.
imperium.dlg.greet.homeless.0: Sorry about the smell. I sleep in the pigsty. The pigs complained first.
imperium.dlg.greet.homeless.1: Twelve of us in one hut, %1$s. Somebody's elbow is always in my ear.
imperium.dlg.greet.homeless.2: Build more houses, I beg you. I'm tired of sleeping standing up.
imperium.dlg.greet.hungry.0: Rations are getting smaller every week. Soon they'll be purely theoretical.
imperium.dlg.greet.hungry.1: Hello, %1$s. You wouldn't happen to have a turnip on you?
imperium.dlg.greet.hungry.2: My stomach growls louder than the army drums.
imperium.dlg.greet.normal.2: Another day in %5$s. Same mud, same chickens.
imperium.dlg.greet.unhappy.0: What do you want? Taxes? Take my last chicken, why don't you.
imperium.dlg.greet.unhappy.1: Long live... hm, whoever is in charge this week.
imperium.dlg.greet.unhappy.2: Don't mind me, I'm just quietly contemplating a revolution.
imperium.dlg.greet.war.0: Keep your voice down, %1$s! Spies of %3$s are everywhere.
imperium.dlg.greet.war.1: Is it true the army of %3$s is marching on %5$s?
imperium.dlg.greet.war.2: My son went to the front. I sharpen my scythe every evening, just in case.
imperium.dlg.how.abundant.0: Splendid! I've eaten so well I can't see my own feet.
imperium.dlg.how.abundant.1: We have so much bread we've started building with it.
imperium.dlg.how.abundant.2: I named my new piglet after the ruler. It's a compliment, I swear.
imperium.dlg.how.enemy.0: How am I? Your people are burning my village! How do you think?!
imperium.dlg.how.enemy.1: I was fine until your army showed up.
imperium.dlg.how.famine.0: How am I? I ate grass this morning. It tasted like regret.
imperium.dlg.how.famine.1: My children ask for bread and I tell them stories about bread.
imperium.dlg.how.famine.2: Old Wojtek died last night. We buried him with his spoon. He would have wanted that.
imperium.dlg.how.famine.3: If the ruler of %2$s doesn't build farms soon, there won't be anyone left to tax.
imperium.dlg.how.foreign.0: Fine, until your countrymen start trouble.
imperium.dlg.how.foreign.1: Life in %2$s is quiet. Let's keep it that way, yes?
imperium.dlg.how.happy.0: Couldn't be better! I got married last week. To the miller's daughter. Or the miller. I was drunk.
imperium.dlg.how.happy.1: Life is good in %2$s. Even the taxes feel almost voluntary.
imperium.dlg.how.happy.2: Happy as a pig in mud, %1$s!
imperium.dlg.how.homeless.0: I sleep under a cart. It's cosy until somebody drives off.
imperium.dlg.how.homeless.1: Do you know how cold it is to sleep in a barrel?
imperium.dlg.how.homeless.2: The ruler should build houses, not monuments to their own ego.
imperium.dlg.how.hungry.1: We're eating the seed grain now. Next year will be... interesting.
imperium.dlg.how.hungry.2: Could be worse. Could be raining. Oh wait, it is.
imperium.dlg.how.normal.0: Can't complain. Well, I can, but nobody listens.
imperium.dlg.how.normal.1: Same as yesterday. Hopefully same as tomorrow.
imperium.dlg.how.normal.2: My back hurts, my goat bites, but the harvest was alright.
imperium.dlg.how.normal.3: Fine, thank you. You're the first person to ask in years.
imperium.dlg.how.unhappy.0: Taxes, mud and boredom. The holy trinity of %2$s.
imperium.dlg.how.unhappy.1: Some say we should march on the capital with torches. I'm just repeating what some say.
imperium.dlg.how.unhappy.2: Even the priest stopped praying for the ruler. Now he prays for us.
imperium.dlg.how.war.0: I can't sleep. Every night I hear drums from the border with %3$s.
imperium.dlg.how.war.1: They took my horse for the cavalry. I hope he's a general by now.
imperium.dlg.how.war.2: If %3$s comes here, I've got a pitchfork and a very bad temper.
imperium.dlg.how.war.3: My brother died defending the tower. Make it count, %1$s.
imperium.dlg.joke.abundant.0: We eat so much in %2$s that our sheep went on a diet out of solidarity.
imperium.dlg.joke.abundant.1: Our bard ate his lute. It was made of gingerbread. Good times.
imperium.dlg.joke.famine.0: Why does everyone in %2$s stand so straight? Nothing in our stomachs to weigh us down.
imperium.dlg.joke.famine.1: My diet is going great. Not by choice.
imperium.dlg.joke.famine.2: What's for dinner? A story about dinner.
imperium.dlg.joke.normal.0: Why didn't the skeleton join the army? It had no guts.
imperium.dlg.joke.normal.1: A villager walks into a smithy. 'Hmm.' Walks out. 'Hmm.'
imperium.dlg.joke.normal.2: My wife said I should dig more. So I dug a hole. Now I live in it. She was right.
imperium.dlg.joke.normal.3: Why don't endermen play cards? Someone always looks them in the eye.
imperium.dlg.joke.normal.4: I asked the librarian for a book about Nether portals. She said it's out of this world.
imperium.dlg.joke.unhappy.0: What's the difference between our ruler and a creeper? The creeper only blows up your house once.
imperium.dlg.joke.unhappy.1: Taxes in %2$s are like rain. Constant, cold, and nobody ordered them.
imperium.dlg.joke.war.0: How many soldiers of %3$s does it take to light a torch? None, they're afraid of the dark.
imperium.dlg.joke.war.1: The army of %3$s is so slow that snails overtake it on the way to battle.
imperium.dlg.joke.war.2: Our general shouted: shields up! So we sold them. Prices were up.
imperium.dlg.news.ally.0: We're allied with %3$s now. Their bread is terrible, but their swords are sharp.
imperium.dlg.news.ally.1: An envoy from %3$s came by. Wore a hat taller than our church.
imperium.dlg.news.building.0: Have you seen our new building, %5$s? Fancy! We'll all be rich now. Probably.
imperium.dlg.news.building.1: They finally finished the %5$s. It took longer than my marriage.
imperium.dlg.news.famine.0: The neighbours are leaving for other lands. Can't blame them.
imperium.dlg.news.famine.1: The rats left too. That's when you know it's bad.
imperium.dlg.news.lost.0: We lost a province. Grandma says it's the first time since the Great Pig Plague.
imperium.dlg.news.lost.1: Refugees keep coming from the border. They have nothing left but stories.
imperium.dlg.news.peace.0: Nothing happens here. The last big news was a cow escaping.
imperium.dlg.news.peace.1: Peace with %3$s holds. For now. Peace is just a deep breath before the shouting.
imperium.dlg.news.rich.0: They say the treasury is full of gold. I've never seen any of it, but it's nice to know.
imperium.dlg.news.rich.1: Merchants from %3$s come to trade with us. We must be doing something right.
imperium.dlg.news.strongest.0: Word is %3$s is the mightiest realm around. Makes you nervous.
imperium.dlg.news.strongest.1: Travellers say %3$s has more soldiers than trees.
imperium.dlg.news.war.0: They say %2$s and %3$s are at war. In the tavern the odds are three to one.
imperium.dlg.news.war.1: Soldiers marched through last night and took all our eggs. For morale, they said.
imperium.dlg.recruit.foreign.0: Join YOUR army? I'm loyal to %2$s, thank you very much.
imperium.dlg.recruit.full.0: They say the army is full. Not even room for a drummer.
imperium.dlg.recruit.no.famine.0: I can barely lift a spoon, let alone a sword.
imperium.dlg.recruit.no.happy.0: Why would I go to war? Life is perfect here!
imperium.dlg.recruit.no.happy.1: And leave my garden? The tomatoes would never forgive me.
imperium.dlg.recruit.no.normal.0: Me? A soldier? I faint at the sight of jam.
imperium.dlg.recruit.no.normal.1: Sorry, my cow needs me. She's very demanding.
imperium.dlg.recruit.no.war.0: I have six children! Who will feed them if %3$s gets me?
imperium.dlg.recruit.nobarracks.0: Join what army? There aren't even barracks here.
imperium.dlg.recruit.nobarracks.1: Build barracks first, then we'll talk about glory.
imperium.dlg.recruit.yes.famine.0: Do soldiers get fed? Then I'm your man!
imperium.dlg.recruit.yes.famine.1: I'd fight a dragon for a bowl of soup. Sign me up.
imperium.dlg.recruit.yes.happy.0: Why not! Adventure, glory, a free helmet!
imperium.dlg.recruit.yes.normal.0: For %2$s! Where do I get my sword? Is it pointy?
imperium.dlg.recruit.yes.normal.1: Fine, fine. Anything to get away from my mother-in-law.
imperium.dlg.recruit.yes.war.0: %3$s burned my father's farm. Give me a spear.
imperium.dlg.recruit.yes.war.1: I'll defend %5$s with my life! ...Hopefully not with all of it.
imperium.dlg.ruler.hate.0: The ruler? I'd say it to their face, but I like my head where it is.
imperium.dlg.ruler.hate.1: We're starving and they build statues. Statues! Of themselves!
imperium.dlg.ruler.hate.2: There's talk of a new ruler. Maybe a goat. The goat has better ideas.
imperium.dlg.ruler.love.0: Our ruler? A saint! Low taxes, full plates. Long may they reign!
imperium.dlg.ruler.love.1: I hung a portrait of the ruler above my bed. My wife is jealous.
imperium.dlg.ruler.love.2: The best ruler %2$s ever had. Don't tell the previous one.
imperium.dlg.ruler.ok.0: Could be worse. The last one fed the treasury to a dragon.
imperium.dlg.ruler.ok.1: They're alright. Mostly. Sometimes. On Tuesdays.
imperium.dlg.ruler.ok.2: As long as there's bread and no war, I don't care who sits on the throne.
imperium.dlg.soldier.dismiss.0: Free at last! I'm going home to my cabbages.
imperium.dlg.soldier.dismiss.1: An honourable discharge? I'll take it. Farewell, commander!
imperium.dlg.soldier.enemy.1: You'll get nothing from me but cold steel.
imperium.dlg.soldier.follow.2: Following. Try not to walk into lava.
imperium.dlg.soldier.foreign.2: Nice armour. Is it from %3$s? Ours is better.
imperium.dlg.soldier.greet.famine.0: Commander... can we fight on empty stomachs? Asking for the whole regiment.
imperium.dlg.soldier.greet.famine.1: I ate my belt. The leather one. The others are eyeing their boots.
imperium.dlg.soldier.greet.happy.0: Morale is excellent, commander! We even started a choir.
imperium.dlg.soldier.greet.happy.1: Good food, good pay, good weather. Is this a trap?
imperium.dlg.soldier.greet.normal.2: All quiet on our front. Too quiet.
imperium.dlg.soldier.greet.unpaid.0: With respect, commander, when do we get paid? Sharpening isn't free.
imperium.dlg.soldier.greet.unpaid.1: The lads are muttering about deserting. I'm not. Yet.
imperium.dlg.soldier.greet.war.0: Give the word and we'll march on the enemy!
imperium.dlg.soldier.greet.war.1: My blade is sharp and my nerves are... mostly fine.
imperium.dlg.soldier.greet.war.2: For %2$s! Point me at the enemy.
imperium.dlg.soldier.hold.0: I'll hold this position. Nobody passes!
imperium.dlg.soldier.hold.1: Standing guard. Like a very determined tree.
imperium.dlg.soldier.morale.famine.0: Morale? We're boiling our shields for soup, commander.
imperium.dlg.soldier.morale.famine.1: A man can't fight on hope alone. We need bread.
imperium.dlg.soldier.morale.high.0: We'd follow you into the Nether, commander!
imperium.dlg.soldier.morale.high.1: Spirits are high. Somebody even polished the helmets.
imperium.dlg.soldier.morale.low.0: Honestly? The men are tired and scared.
imperium.dlg.soldier.morale.low.1: Half the regiment wants to go home. The other half already left.
imperium.dlg.soldier.morale.ok.0: Morale's fine. Food's fine. The sergeant snores, though.
imperium.dlg.soldier.morale.unpaid.0: No pay for weeks. The men are selling their arrows.
imperium.dlg.soldier.morale.unpaid.1: We fight for %2$s... but %2$s should pay us.
imperium.dlg.soldier.return.0: Back to the barracks. Hope there's soup.
imperium.dlg.subtitle: %s of %s
imperium.dlg.threaten.give.0: Take it! Take everything! Just leave my goat!
imperium.dlg.threaten.give.1: H-here, my savings. Please just go away.
imperium.dlg.work.farmer.0: Wheat, carrots, potatoes. And one very suspicious pumpkin.
imperium.dlg.work.farmer.1: If you trample my farmland, I will haunt you.
imperium.dlg.work.merchant.0: Buy low, sell high, and never trust anyone from %3$s.
imperium.dlg.work.merchant.1: I sell emeralds, carpets and slightly used horses.
imperium.dlg.work.miner.0: I dig. Down. It's not complicated, but it's honest.
imperium.dlg.work.miner.1: Found diamonds once. Then lava found me. Long story.
imperium.dlg.work.peasant.0: I do a bit of everything. Mostly mud.
imperium.dlg.work.peasant.1: Carry this, dig that, feed those. The noble life of a peasant.
imperium.dlg.work.priest.0: I pray for the harvest, the army and your soul. Mostly the harvest.
imperium.dlg.work.priest.1: Ring the bell, light the candles, hope for the best.
imperium.dlg.work.scholar.0: I'm researching why the sky is blue. Funding is... limited.
imperium.dlg.work.scholar.1: Knowledge is power. It's also very heavy when it's in books.
imperium.dlg.work.smith.0: Iron goes in, steel comes out, and my eyebrows go missing.
imperium.dlg.work.smith.1: The smeltery makes the best steel in %2$s. And the worst air.
imperium.dlg.work.woodcutter.0: I cut trees. I swear the trees have started to bite back.
imperium.dlg.work.woodcutter.1: Logs for the mill, planks for the houses, splinters for me.
imperium.dlgopt.ruler: What do you think of the ruler?

imperium.err.bad_relation: Not possible with the current relations.

imperium.err.foreign_treasury: This treasury is on foreign soil.
imperium.err.grace: Peace period! Wars are possible in %s s.
imperium.err.leader_only: Only the leader of your nation can do that.
imperium.err.max_buildings: You can have at most %s of these.
imperium.err.near_core: Too close to a province tower.
imperium.err.need_nations: You need at least 2 nations with territory.
imperium.err.no_nation: You don't belong to any nation.
imperium.err.no_prefab: This building can't be bought ready-made.
imperium.err.not_at_war: You are not at war with them.
imperium.err.not_own_territory: The whole plot must be inside your territory.
imperium.err.not_resource: The treasury doesn't accept this item.
imperium.err.pending: That proposal is already waiting for an answer.
imperium.err.truce: Truce in force for another %s s.
imperium.err.water: You can't mark a plot on water.
imperium.help.1: Admin: /imperium arena <size>, /imperium autodivide <nations> <provinces>, /imperium start, /imperium grace <seconds> (or the Editor tab in the strategy view).
imperium.help.2: Players: /imperium join <nation> or press N. G toggles the strategy (RTS) view.
imperium.help.3: Build: in the RTS view pick a building, mark the plot, then build it by hand in first person - the HUD lists the blocks you need. Or buy a ready-made one.
imperium.help.4: Economy: deposit materials in the National Treasury (in your capital tower). Buildings produce resources every cycle.
imperium.help.5: Army: build Barracks, recruit units in the Army tab, select them with the mouse and right click to give orders.
imperium.help.6: War: declare war in Diplomacy, then destroy the core in the enemy province tower to capture the province.
imperium.help.7: Talk to citizens (right click) - their mood depends on food, happiness and war.
imperium.help.8: K - technology tree, N - nation & diplomacy, B - show/hide borders.
imperium.hud.no_nation: No nation - press N to join one
imperium.hud.setup_hint: G - strategy view, N - join a nation
imperium.insult.0: The ruler of %s declared that %s smells of wet goats.
imperium.insult.1: %s sent %s a portrait of a turnip titled 'Your ruler'.
imperium.insult.2: The envoy of %s laughed at the army of %s for a full minute.
imperium.insult.3: %s announced that %s couldn't build a hut even with instructions.
imperium.insult.4: %s claims the bread of %s is used as a building material.
imperium.insult.5: The court jester of %s does a very rude impression of the ruler of %s.
imperium.insult.6: %s publicly wonders whether %s has ever won anything. Ever.
imperium.insult.7: %s named their pigsty after the capital of %s.

imperium.msg.gift_received: %s sends you a gift of %s gold!

imperium.tech.agriculture.desc: Farms produce +3 food. Unlocks the Granary.
imperium.tech.archery.desc: Unlocks the Archery Range and archers.
imperium.tech.architecture.desc: +20% housing. Unlocks the Stone House and the Manor.
imperium.tech.diplomacy.desc: Allows proposing alliances and non-aggression pacts.
imperium.tech.fortification.desc: Province cores +50% HP. Unlocks the Fortress.
imperium.tech.gunpowder.desc: Sappers deal double damage to cores.
imperium.tech.metallurgy.desc: Unlocks the Smeltery and steel production.
imperium.tech.siege.desc: Unlocks the Siege Workshop and sappers.
imperium.tech.trade.desc: Unlocks the Market and trade agreements.
imperium.tech.writing.desc: +1 research per cycle. Unlocks the Academy.
imperium.ui.army_hint: Click a unit to recruit (Shift: 5 at once).
imperium.ui.attack_core_hint: Right click the core icon to besiege it
imperium.ui.dismiss_hint: Hold Shift and click to dismiss the selected soldiers.
imperium.ui.editor.name: Name
imperium.ui.editor.owner_tip: Give the selected province to the selected nation
imperium.ui.editor.wipe_tip: Shift+click: delete all nations and provinces
imperium.ui.hint.editor: LMB paint | RMB erase | Shift/Ctrl: bigger brush | Esc: stop

imperium.ui.hint.place: LMB place | RMB / Esc cancel | R rotate entrance
imperium.ui.hint.world: LMB select | RMB attack-move (Alt: march) | WASD QE wheel: camera | M map | Space: you
imperium.ui.lobby_empty: No nations yet. An admin must create them in the strategy view editor.
imperium.ui.manual_hint: Mark a plot, then go there in first person and place the listed blocks yourself - any shape you like!
imperium.ui.no_arena: No arena yet - an admin can set it in the Editor tab
imperium.ui.no_prefab: Can only be built by hand
imperium.ui.placing: Placing: %s - left click to place, right click to cancel, R to rotate, Shift to place more.
imperium.ui.prefab_hint: Ready-made buildings appear instantly and cost resources from the treasury. Click a building, then the ground. R rotates.
imperium.ui.setup_bar: Preparation phase - join a nation (Nation button)
imperium.ui.treasury_hint: Right click the treasury with logs, stone, iron, gold, steel, food or books to deposit them.
imperium.ui.war_confirm: Hold Shift and click again to declare war.
imperium.unit.archer.desc: Shoots from afar, keeps distance from melee attackers.
imperium.unit.knight.desc: Full steel armour and a steel sword. Expensive and terrifying.
imperium.unit.militia.desc: Cheap conscripts with stone swords. Better than nothing.
imperium.unit.sapper.desc: Deals 6x damage to province cores. Escort them!
imperium.unit.swordsman.desc: Iron sword, chainmail and a shield. The backbone of the army.
